summary: Frontend-only test (mobile 390x844) of: (1) color revert to black #121212 + orange #ff6b00, (2) Home giant CTAs, (3) Laboratorio 'generator on top' Fase 3 ordering, (4) BottomNav peel tabs navigation. Admin login (admin@mikilab.de) works. 3 of 4 requested features fully PASS; color revert is 99% done with 1 concrete leftover. Two extra issues found: BottomNav wood-brown background and missing PaywallGate on the Laboratorio for anonymous users.

ui_bugs.issue: COLOR REVERT MISS: giant CTA 'ENTRA NEL LABORATORIO' still uses the cancelled warm palette gradient #d9822b -> #f29a38 (computed rgb(217,130,43) -> rgb(242,154,56)). Only leftover of the warm palette found in the whole src tree (grep for 3E2723/C85A32/D9822B matches this single line). Should be #ff6b00/#c94f00 like the sibling ricette CTA.

BottomNav container background is computed rgb(122,74,36) = #7a4a24 (wood brown) plus wood-stripe repeating gradient. If the user asked to remove ALL brown/wood tones this is a leftover; if the wooden shelf behind the peels is intentional, confirm with user. Contrast of the active tab label on the brown wood is acceptable but low-ish.

Text overlap/legibility: 'I plan production in the bakery' + 'MikiLab' + 'Step into the digital bakery' are drawn directly over the avatar photo; the subtitle is clipped/overlapped by the floating Radio button and the flag row. Also the floating 'Radio' pill label is cut off by the bottom nav.
Hero subtitle 'Artisan recipes explained step by step, with my method' sits on a busy bread photo without a dark scrim -> poor contrast/illegible on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: With cookies cleared and NO login (login-btn visible), nav-tab-maestro renders the FULL Laboratorio: maestro-top-tools, PianoProduzioneAI, lab-wizard, and maestro-top-settimana opens the complete Weekly Plan tool. No paywall/upgrade element found at all (searched testids matching paywall|upgrade|subscribe -> []). Premium lab content is free for anonymous users.

issues: body background rgb(18,18,18) and text rgb(224,213,207) = correct black theme
maestro-top-* buttons use correct linear-gradient(#ff6b00 -> #c94f00) with white text
No #3E2723 / #C85A32 computed anywhere; only the Home lab CTA carries #d9822b

action_items: Home.jsx line 328: replace from-[#d9822b] to-[#f29a38] (and hover pair) with the black/orange palette (#ff6b00 -> #c94f00) to complete the color revert.
Decide/confirm the BottomNav wood-brown bar (#7a4a24 in index.css:161) — remove if brown tones must be gone.
Restore PaywallGate feature='lab' on the Maestro/Laboratorio section: anonymous users currently get full access to the generator and all tools.

Add a dark scrim (or move text below the image) on the Home avatar card and the Ricette hero to fix text-over-photo legibility; fix the floating Radio button overlapping/being clipped by the bottom nav.
Give the PianoProduzioneAI root a data-testid (e.g. maestro-pianoai-root) — it currently has none, ordering could only be verified indirectly via capo-* children.
critical_code_review_comments: Maestro.jsx renders a single ~5.1k px tall PianoProduzioneAI block between maestro-top-tools (y=281) and avatar-bubbles (y=5443); avatar/wizard are effectively unreachable without heavy scrolling on mobile. Consider collapsing PianoProduzioneAI by default.
Palette values are hardcoded per-component (149 files touched for the revert). Extract #121212/#ff6b00/#c94f00 into CSS variables / tailwind theme tokens to avoid future misses like Home.jsx:328.
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! — login via login-btn -> auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit works, 'Welcome!' toast shown, login-btn replaced by logout icon.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VERIFIED PASSING: (a) Home giant CTAs — home-hero-ricette-giant-cta navigates to [data-testid='ricette-page'], home-hero-laboratorio-giant-cta navigates to the Laboratorio; (b) Fase 3 ordering in Maestro measured by scrollY: maestro-title 81 -> maestro-top-tools 281 -> PianoProduzioneAI (capo-setup-hint 664 / capo-quicklinks 884) -> avatar-bubbles 5443 -> lab-wizard 5737 = required order OK; all 4 XL buttons (maestro-top-settimana/metodo/sequenze/convlievito) present; clicking maestro-top-settimana opens the Weekly plan view and maestro-back-btn returns to the tools list; (c) all 5 bottom-nav peel tabs (home/ricette/maestro/impara/community) clickable and navigate. Popups to dismiss: lab-tour-skip, newsletter-popup-dismiss. Note ~4 console 401 errors on anonymous load (expected: /api/auth/me style calls).
rca_of_the_issue: The warm->black palette revert was done by a bulk find/replace across 149 files; Home.jsx:328 used the warm hexes inside a Tailwind gradient with hover variants (from-[#d9822b] hover:from-[#f29a38]) and was missed. The BottomNav brown comes from a separate CSS class in index.css (#7a4a24), not from component classnames, so the bulk replace never touched it.
